A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same heterogeneous WCMDP study despite the changed title and organization. Their complete text, algorithms, equations, and appendices support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 presents algorithms and theoretical guarantees with proofs. Neither the main text nor the appendices report original empirical results.

after.justification: v3 likewise contains theoretical analysis and proofs, including revised bounds, but no original experiments, simulations, or data-analysis results.

M1.justification: The LP-based policies, ID reassignment, and priority-ordered action execution remain. However, v3 fixes the reassignment threshold at δ = α_min/4 instead of accepting any input δ between zero and α_min/2, narrowing the previously parameterized procedure.

E1.justification: Neither version uses datasets or conducts empirical task evaluations. The revised theoretical assumptions do not constitute evaluated coverage.

E2.justification: Neither version experimentally evaluates comparison methods. Additional policies discussed in related work are citations, not evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Neither version reports an experimental evaluation protocol, data splits, evaluation metrics, or training budgets.

E4.justification: Neither version includes empirical ablations, robustness tests, sensitivity studies, or case studies. The appendix revisions concern mathematical proofs.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated empirical runs, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Probabilistic inequalities appear solely in theoretical analysis.

E6.justification: Neither version reports empirical performance values, rankings, or qualitative experimental findings. Changes to analytical guarantees and constants are assessed under T1.

T1.justification: Assumption 1 replaces a uniform spectral-gap bound with a uniform mixing-time bound. v3 Appendix E.1 replaces v1 Appendix D.1's spectral lemmas with an infinity-norm mixing argument, and subsequent drift proofs and constants are revised. v3 corrects factors in Lemma 4 and the non-shrinking proof and derives explicit parameter dependence for C_ID in Appendix G.2, including exact optimality when budgets are vacuous.

C1.justification: The first O(1/√N) guarantee for fully heterogeneous average-reward WCMDPs and the projection-based Lyapunov contribution remain. v3 drops v1's introductory assertion that its assumptions are weaker than most prior assumptions and presents the guarantee under the reformulated mixing-time premise.

C2.justification: v3 adds explanations of how persistent ID priorities support convergence and how reassignment avoids cost plateaus that cause sensitivity to action sampling. Section 4 also newly emphasizes that the analysis targets scaling in N and does not optimize dependence on other parameters.

D1.justification: Algorithm 1 and Appendix C now specify the concrete threshold δ = α_min/4, replacing v1's admissible input range. Neither version supplies code, hardware information, or empirical implementation resources.

R1.justification: v3 expands positioning toward reinforcement learning, presenting the planning result as a potential building block for model-based learning. It adds Hodge and Glazebrook and Xiong et al. to the closest WCMDP discussion. Appendix A substantively revises prior results' coverage and horizon-dependence exceptions, including distinguishing typed from fully heterogeneous nondegeneracy guarantees. The Kozyakin citation disappears with the spectral proof.

P1.justification: The title, abstract, introduction, and policy explanations are revised. ID reassignment is integrated into Section 3, its detailed analysis moves into Appendix C, and the former main-text proof section becomes Appendix D. These changes substantially reorganize the narrative while retaining much of the underlying material.

P2.justification: The two existing algorithm displays exchange numbers and appear together on v3 page 7 rather than on separate pages. Abstract formatting, contents layout, typography, and link styling change, while the single-column mathematical format remains. Neither version contains figures or research tables.

improvement.justification: v3 replaces the cumbersome spectral argument with a direct mixing-time proof and corrects factors in Lemma 4 and the non-shrinking proof. Explicit parameter dependence and clearer qualifications improve interpretation. These gains are partly offset by new local slips, such as the missing factor 2 in Eq. (79), which reappears in the subsequent definition of K_V.
